spl_unclassified_section: Rolaids Advanced Antacid plus Anti-Gas Chewable Tablets ( Wild Berry ) Drug Facts
Other information ■ each tablet contains: calcium 400 mg, magnesium 85 mg ■ store at room temperature 20°-25°C (68°-77°F).
active_ingredient: Active ingredients (in each tablet) Calcium carbonate USP 1000 mg Magnesium hydroxide USP 200 mg Simethicone USP 40 mg
indications_and_usage: Uses for the relief of: ■ heartburn ■ sour stomach ■ acid indigestion ■ upset stomach associated with these symptoms ■ pressure and bloating, commonly referred to as gas, associated with these symptoms
warnings: Warnings Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are now taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. When using this product ■ do not take more than 7 tablets in a 24-hour period ■ do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks Keep out of reach of children.
ask_doctor_or_pharmacist: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are now taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.
when_using: When using this product ■ do not take more than 7 tablets in a 24-hour period ■ do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children.
dosage_and_administration: Directions ■ chew 2-3 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients corn starch, dextrose, FD&C blue no. 1 lake, FD&C red no. 40 lake, magnesium stearate, maltodextrin, natural and artificial flavor, propylene glycol alginate, silicon dioxide, stearic acid, sucrose, triacetin
